title: Use of Marijuana: Effect on Brain Health: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association

recommendations.classNote: Scope summary quoted from the publication abstract; the full graded recommendations are in the linked source.
recommendations.text: Marijuana is perceived as a harmless drug, and its recreational use has gained popularity among young individuals. The concentration of active ingredients in recreational formulations has gradually increased over time, and high-potency illicit cannabinomimetics have become available. Thus, the consumption of cannabis in the general population is rising.
